relationship_to_existing_books: Candidate C is tested first as a standalone edge and then only as a frozen 20% sleeve in A/B/C = 40/40/20. It does not replace or retune Book A or Book B after results are seen.
hypothesis: A fresh, high-quality 1h order block aligned with causal 4h support/resistance has edge only after the first return removes liquidity beyond the distal edge and a completed 5m bar reclaims the entire zone.

data.source: Binance public USD-M checksumed 1m kline and funding archives
data.true_oos: First UTC midnight after protocol and code freeze; minimum 180 days, 50 fills and 30 independent 4h event clusters

level.order_block: exactly the last opposing candle among the prior 3 bars

freshness_and_merge.merge_rule: oldest ID, boundaries and TTL survive; alias cannot refresh or resurrect the level

trigger.entry: market/taker at the next actual 1m open
trigger.gap_through: observed and terminally invalidated, never silently skipped

risk.stop: actual sweep extreme plus 0.10 ATR buffer
risk.target: exactly 2.0 net-R under stress fees/slippage and before the nearest causal opposing level

primary_portfolio_comparison.required_stress_return_improvement_each_: max(0.50 percentage point, 10% of absolute benchmark return)
primary_portfolio_comparison.maximum_challenger_drawdown: min(benchmark DD + 0.50 percentage point, 1.10 * benchmark DD)

disclosure: Retrospective research only. Historical windows overlap earlier S87-S89 discovery, so even a full pass permits paper-forward, never immediate live trading or a guarantee of profit.
